name: Excelsior
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
With the inside finished, all that's left is to add the outer layer. For this, I use only the best elder croc skins. They are more durable and a better canvas--if you will--for adding the designs and accents that make Drizzlik's Excelsior line.

It's hard to find that perfect skin though, the only one that fits my plan is the skin of an elder saltwater crocolisk. The elders only come out to defend the other saltwater crocs, so you might need to kill a few to draw one out.
narrative.objectives: Bring an Elder Crocolisk Skin to Drizzlik in Booty Bay.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Great! Thanks to your help I'll have this order filled and sent off to Director Riddlevox on the next boat to Undermine. Ahead of schedule, even!

For all your hard work, here, I made some extras, so take a pair. It's on Drizzlik.

And remember, there's no boot so fine as one of Drizzlik's Excelsior line!
narrative.requestItemsText:
I read somewhere that the saltwater crocilisks are slowly dying out... bad news for my business, isn't it?

Anyways, I hope you have that elder saltwater crocolisk skin for me!
